description: The chart titled “Model Evaluation on Academic and …” illustrates a side-by-side comparison of two model variants across multiple datasets/metrics, with paired bars for each category. The category axis is horizontal and labeled “Dataset and Metrics,” showing (left to right) GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (+5), and Chat-Arena-Hard; the labels are angled and the categories appear in a fixed listed order rather than being sorted by value. The value axis is vertical and labeled “Score (%)” on a linear scale, spanning approximately 0 to 90 with regularly spaced tick marks at about 10-point intervals. Each category has two adjacent bars: a blue bar (baseline model label in the legend) and an orange bar labeled “Ours (Iterative …)” in the legend; the orange bar is consistently slightly taller than the blue bar in each pair. Approximate bar heights are: GSM-8K ~82 (blue) and ~85 (orange), MMLU ~77 and ~79, HumanEval ~80 and ~84, TruthfulQA ~70 and ~86, ARC ~86 and ~90, MBPP ~90 and ~91, LC AlpacaEval-2 ~71 and ~80, MT-Bench (+5) ~88 and ~90, and Chat-Arena-Hard ~82 and ~87. The bars are not stacked, there are no visible error bars or annotations, and no individual bars appear specially emphasized beyond the consistent color coding and the legend.
